# PR #3180: Patch: follow-up to #3165 from the after-merge spot-check

Closes #3176

`main` builds again. `tally` in `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs` called `RunNodeKind::is_boss`, a method #3145 removed, so `jackioh-tools` and the workspace's build, clippy and tests failed to compile. I followed the issue's plan as written.

## What changed

The only file changed is `crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`.

- **The fix:** in `tally`, `fight.kind.is_boss()` is now `matches!(fight.kind, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss | RunNodeKind::Boss)`. That is the same test the removed method made. `RunNodeKind` was already imported.
- **A new test,** `the_tally_puts_each_mini_boss_and_the_final_boss_in_act_order`: one won run with a Fight, a MiniBoss, an Elite, a second MiniBoss and the Boss. It checks that `boss_hp` is `[(28, 1), (16, 1), (12, 1)]`: each boss's slot holds the HP the player had entering it, in act order, and the Fight and Elite fill nothing. Until now no test covered the `Boss` case; the existing tally test checks only a MiniBoss.

## How I tested it

- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh run_sim`: 5 passed, 1 ignored. The ignored one is the existing `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` sweep. Both tally tests ran and passed, the new one included.
- **Mutation check:** with `RunNodeKind::Boss` taken out of the `matches!`, the new test fails (`left: [(28, 1), (16, 1), (0, 0)]`, `right: [(28, 1), (16, 1), (12, 1)]`) and the old one still passes. I then restored it; the diff shows both cases.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` (the whole crate) passed: the binary's tests had 500 passed and 6 ignored, and the `acceptance`, `export_card_modes`, `export_card_text`, `golden` and `luau` suites all passed. All 6 ignored tests were already marked `#[ignore]` on `main`; this diff adds none.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` are both clean.
- `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh spec check` all pass (spec check: 1721 rulings, 4195 proofs, ok).
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` prints `classify: Internal`, so no patch fragment is needed.
- `git grep -n 'is_boss()' -- crates` finds nothing.

I did not run the full `cargo test --workspace` or the web tests locally. No other crate and no web file changed; the harness runs both.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **Inline `matches!` instead of restoring the method.** I did not put `RunNodeKind::is_boss` back in `crates/run/src/lib.rs`. That keeps the fix to one file and respects #3121's removal of unused code. The cost: if a second caller ever needs this test, it would be worth bringing the method back then.
- **No ruling, no spec note, no patch fragment.** This is tooling code only; it changes no card, catalog entry or engine rule.

## For the reviewer

The `#[ignore]` reason on the daily sweep says "the two run-fight tests above". The new tally test sits between them and the sweep but plays no run fights, so that text is still accurate.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `claude-1`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 10 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 7s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 1s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 3s |
| clippy (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`) | pass | 0s |
| cargo tests (`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`) | pass | 1697s |

       #[test]

                   unlocks,

                   ..start
               },

- **Meaning drift.** `is_boss` was exactly `matches!(self, RunNodeKind::MiniBoss | RunNodeKind::Boss)`, as shown in fb42f52ced's diff. Copy both arms. Leaving out `Boss` would quietly zero the final-boss row of the report, and the new test catches that.

- **Purity (rule 4).** Not affected: `crates/tools` is outside the pure crates.

None. I chose to inline `matches!` in `run_sim.rs` instead of putting `RunNodeKind::is_boss` back in `crates/run/src/lib.rs`. A person who would rather have the method back can make that one-line change instead.
